home.title: Historical Cadastral Maps
home.subtitle: Interactive viewer for historical cadastral maps and plans of the Halychyna (Galicia) region.

perehnoiv.title: Perehnoiv
perehnoiv.description: Historically, the village was part of the Hlyniany starostwo, and later the Złoczów Kreis. The final cadastral map and its accompanying descriptive records are preserved in CDIAL: fond 186, series 6, file 886 and fond 186, series 1, files 2426–2428.

lishchovate.title: Leszczowate (and Wola Maćkowa)
lishchovate.description: Historically, the village was owned by the Kraiński family, within the boundaries of the historical Sanok Kreis. The map is based on an indication sketch from 1852 and the final map (undated, circa 1855) from the State Archive in Przemyśl - Archiwum Geodezyjne. - Leszczowate. - sygn. 3 (56/126/0/649/3) and sygn. 0896M (56/126/0/-/0896M)

home.footer: Maps and data are processed based on original cadastral records from the Central State Historical Archive of Ukraine in Lviv (CDIAL) and the State Archive in Przemyśl (Poland).

perehnoivMap.title: Perehnoiv
perehnoivMap.description: We are actively working on processing archival cadastral maps, georeferencing coordinates, and verifying the lists of historical landowners.
